title: TriageResult
description: Output of solidsdd.run's Triage step: classifies a change and selects an Execution Profile (direct/thin/standard/full). Persisted at .solidsdd/changes/<change_id>/triage-result.json for every change, including direct (L0), which otherwise writes no run-state.json. See reference-src/triage.md for the decision rules.

requested_profile.description: What the user asked for (conversational --profile <x> / profile: <x> token), or auto when unspecified.

effective_profile.description: max(requested_profile, required_minimum_profile) — never lower than the safety floor.

required_minimum_profile.description: Safety floor computed from change_type / risk / complexity / contract_impact / architecture_impact / uncertain, independent of what was requested.

contract_impact.description: Change touches an existing/new OpenAPI, GraphQL schema, OCL/DbC, formal spec, or the Architecture Model.

architecture_impact.description: Change touches structure, module boundaries, or dependency direction (mirrors solidsdd-architecture's own Level-0 trigger check).

uncertain.description: Triage could not confidently classify the change. When true, required_minimum_profile must not be direct or thin (uncertainty is a risk factor, not a reason to default low).

reasons.description: Short human-readable reasons behind the profile decision, e.g. "Existing behavior remains local", "No public contract change".

escalation.description: Present only when this TriageResult supersedes an earlier lower-profile decision for the same change_id.
